critical_code_review_comments: demo_write_guard returns HTTP 423 (Locked) for demo-mode blocked writes — non-standard but semantically defensible; documented in code. Tests now accept 401/403/423.
server.py is ~4222 lines — recommend splitting license/master/plugin/log-source endpoints into their own routers modules.
master-unlock cookie is httponly=False so JS can read it. Since same-origin SPA, consider HttpOnly=True + rely purely on withCredentials to reduce XSS blast radius.
log-source POST accepts license_key both in body AND X-Master-Key header — pick one canonical channel to reduce ambiguity.
